title: Lancashire County Council – A strategic approach to deploying AI in transport
summary: Lancashire reports that AI traffic predictions, junction observations, and congestion analysis support transport decisions and bus-route planning.
account: Lancashire combines Aimsun, VivaCity, and Alchera tools for traffic forecasts, junction observations, and congestion analysis in its Future Mobility Platform. The page says that insights have been used to plan bus routes. It gives no before-and-after congestion, travel-time, service, or safety outcome.
purpose: Provide traffic intelligence and prediction to support transport planning and network management.
system: Future Mobility Platform using Aimsun Real Time, VivaCity sensors, and Alchera Pinch Point Analysis

ratings.reason: The source reports that new traffic intelligence is used in planning, including bus routes. This is an analytical capability gain, without a measured congestion reduction.
Faster journeys, reduced congestion, and improved bus services remain objectives without defined reported outcomes.

ai_role.statement: The source identifies AI-based traffic prediction, visual junction observations, and congestion analysis as inputs to planning. It states that the intelligence has informed bus-route work, without quantifying improved journeys or congestion outcomes.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Lancashire County Council – A strategic approach to deploying AI in transport

produced_by: The program integrates historical and real-time transport data and draws on cross-council technical and procurement expertise.
Different vendor components contribute predictions, observations, and hotspot analysis.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Lancashire uses AI traffic insights to support route planning

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
